research_design.hypothesis: MJ-X01: Zeva's selected compact captures broader, less correlated tenant demand and deeper financeable investor resale than Solstice, after price and costs.
rivals: Location diversity does not transmit to these specific small units.
Solstice also captures employment demand; affordable privacy and lower entry compensate for concentration.
Condition, bays, utilities, actual costs and exit buyer yield explain apparent advantage.
Rail requires a feeder or drive and may already be priced; regional station presence is not project access.
research_design.scope: R231 Zeva and KV14 Solstice; whole-unit ordinary leases, local substitutes and functional transport/employer context. No new IDs or all-area restart.
research_design.stop: Bounded public matched sale/rent and primary access/employer evidence, then calculate reversals and exit affordability; do not repeat portals as a substitute for collections, actual tenant panel, MC accounts or bank approvals.
research_design.preregistration_status: Recorded in session RAM before new public searches, not a separate committed preregistration.

historical_cases.name: Zeva Equine South
historical_cases.match: Live 210k partly furnished sale replaces redirected 200k lead; 1200 furnished and 850 partly furnished whole-unit rents
historical_cases.thesis: Compact operating rent can exceed family yield if furnishing premium is durable
historical_cases.decisive_risk: The 850 same-area counterexample can destroy coverage; stale transfers do not validate undervaluation
historical_cases.price_status: Advertised/indexed amount for conditional analysis, not confirmed effective consideration
historical_cases.rent_status: Working long-term whole-unit scenario informed by asking evidence; not achieved rent
historical_cases.fee_status: Unverified combined management/sinking proxy, not a verified management-only bill
historical_cases.cost_status: Analyst planning allowances; tax and specific cost quotes missing
historical_cases.g0: STOP: no defensible unit-matched normalised clearing interval

historical_cases.name: Solstice @ Pan'gaea
historical_cases.match: Furnished sale; whole-unit rent; parcel use and parking must be established
historical_cases.selection_reason: Low-capital ordinary-income counterexample; tenant depth versus narrower owner exit
historical_cases.price_status: advertised consideration; not agreed or verified effective price
historical_cases.rent_status: scenario informed by asking rents; not achieved rent
historical_cases.fee_status: unverified combined management/sinking proxy; management-only standard unverified
